_note: Unit costs for site work priced by quantity (QuickFit v2 ground quantities). Every value is an editable assumption from the cited range; confirm with local bids. National cost guides are cross-checks, not Pittsburgh quotes.

retainingWallFace.label: Retaining walls
retainingWallFace.unit: $ per sq ft of wall face
retainingWallFace.sourceLabel: Assumption from LawnStarter 2026 retaining wall cost guide: $20–$53 per sq ft of wall face, average $33
retainingWallFace.sourceNote: Wall face = length × height. Walls over 4 ft need an engineered design (IRC R404.4), which can push the cost to the top of the range or above. Confirm with bids.

foundationWallExtra.label: Extra foundation wall (hillside)
foundationWallExtra.sourceLabel: Unverified assumption: $15–$40 per sq ft for poured concrete walls, from a search-engine summary of Angi's 2026 concrete wall cost guide (the page itself could not be opened to check)
foundationWallExtra.sourceNote: Only the wall area beyond a flat lot's foundation; the ordinary foundation is in the construction cost per sq ft.

excavationCut.label: Excavation (cut and haul away)
excavationCut.sourceLabel: Assumption from CostFlowAI 2026 excavation guide: standard soil $50–$100 per cu yd, small residential digs $39–$191, rock $100–$300
excavationCut.sourceNote: Cut only; the soil is assumed hauled away. Likely = middle of the standard-soil range; high = rocky ground. Confirm with bids.

domiPermitPeriod.label: DOMI construction staging permit (street or sidewalk)
domiPermitPeriod.sourceLabel: City of Pittsburgh DOMI Construction Staging Permit information sheet, 2026: $135 at application + $60 at issuance; $280 major obstruction fee over 18 days; $40 extension; $30 per two weeks on primary roads
domiPermitPeriod.sourceNote: Likely = $135 + $60 + $280 for a 42-day period; high adds an extension and primary-road fees; low is a short permit. Parking meter fees (Pittsburgh Parking Authority) are not included.

dumpsterHaul.label: Dumpster haul (30 yard)
dumpsterHaul.sourceLabel: RightDumpster Pittsburgh market estimates (2025): 30-yard $485–$703, average about $594
dumpsterHaul.sourceNote: Construction clean-up is in the construction cost; hauls here are for demolition debris only.

staging.sourceNote: Labeled estimate. Assumptions: 2 staging permit periods (about 12 weeks of street staging when the lot has no room on site) and 5 dumpster hauls when a building is demolished. Confirm with the DOMI permit office and a hauler.

lateral.label: Water and sewer laterals (excavation, street opening, restoration)
lateral.sourceNote: Same default as cost model v0.2 (COST-MODEL-LOCKED §B).
